review_boundary.historical_palette_quarantine_use: Evidence within frozen distinctiveness/genericity tasks only; not a new criterion.

controls.CNEG: Negative low-identity calibration control; not a Kymaean-family selection candidate.
controls.CCONV: Conventional product-blue calibration control; method explicitly excludes it from Kymaean-family selection.

F1.name: Split Temperature
F1.cross_surface_family_coherence: PASS — restrained APP and warmer WEB remain visibly one warm/cool role logic.
F1.distinctiveness: BORDERLINE — the warm-earth hinge gives character, but the stripped carrier reads more like familiar premium editorial/heritage styling than a uniquely ownable Kymaean mechanism.
F1.genericity: CONCERN — the frozen method already names heritage/editorial warmth as its primary risk; the post-freeze Drive quarantine also finds family-level resemblance to prior warm-earth material exploration even though no exact fixture hex was copied.
F1.calm_low_fatigue_compatibility: PASS — quiet fields, restrained accent and stable hierarchy remain calm in APP and WEB.
F1.semantic_honesty: PASS — the rust accent behaves as neutral emphasis/action rather than status, identity or authority in this carrier.
F1.fallback_resilience: PASS — mechanically confirmed with forced colors active and color suppressed.

F2.name: Monochrome + Intruder
F2.cross_surface_family_coherence: PASS — both contexts preserve a violet-neutral structural field with a scarce teal interruption while WEB strengthens expression without changing topology.
F2.distinctiveness: PASS — of the scored families, this mechanism remains the most legible as a relationship among roles rather than simply an attractive palette; scarcity makes the accent feel intentional without requiring other identity carriers.
F2.genericity: PASS_WITH_WATCH — violet/teal creative-tool familiarity is a real risk, but the fixture's broad near-monochrome distribution plus rare teal is less category-conventional than CCONV and less trope-bound than the other scored families.
F2.calm_low_fatigue_compatibility: PASS — the chroma concentration is low and the accent is sparse, compatible with restrained motion rather than competing with it.
F2.semantic_honesty: PASS — teal marks only the frozen non-semantic strip and neutral action/focus role; it does not imply state, success, priority, identity or authority.
F2.fallback_resilience: PASS — mechanically confirmed with forced colors active and color suppressed.

F3.name: Complementary Poles
F3.cross_surface_family_coherence: PASS — APP/WEB preserve the same green-field/plum-accent opposition.
F3.distinctiveness: BORDERLINE — the opposition is immediately visible, but its character comes from a familiar green/plum pairing rather than a less expected role logic.
F3.genericity: CONCERN — on neutral content the family leans strongly toward botanical/wellness associations, matching the frozen method's named risk; the complementary-pole signal is more trope-like than specifically Kymaean.
F3.calm_low_fatigue_compatibility: PASS — low-chroma fields remain calm despite the stronger accent contrast.
F3.semantic_honesty: PASS_WITH_WATCH — no status is actually encoded, but the green field plus red-adjacent plum increases future collision pressure with common semantic-color expectations.
F3.fallback_resilience: PASS — mechanically confirmed with forced colors active and color suppressed.

F4.name: Chromatic Ladder
F4.cross_surface_family_coherence: PASS — APP/WEB clearly share a warm-neutral field and blue structural ladder.
F4.distinctiveness: FAIL_SUBJECTIVE — the distributed blue roles are polished but do not create recognizable character beyond familiar digital-product color treatment in the stripped carrier.
F4.genericity: FAIL_SUBJECTIVE — despite the warmer field, it remains visually too close to the conventional product-blue category represented by CCONV, which is exactly the frozen method's named risk.
F4.semantic_honesty: PASS — no state or authority meaning is carried by blue in the neutral fixture.
F4.fallback_resilience: PASS — mechanically confirmed with forced colors active and color suppressed.

independent_recommendation: Advance F2 as Design Sol's provisional CLR-01 survivor. Keep F1 visible to the Director as the strongest alternative but do not recommend it as primary because its identity is less independent of familiar editorial/warm-earth conventions. Do not advance F3 or F4 on Design Sol's view.
authority_limit: This freezes Design Sol's independent pre-Director view only. It is not Director adjudication, final palette authority, Phase-C identity authority, semantic-status color authority, app implementation validation, or website theme selection.
